spans.s:
विक् विक्, (in Pāṇini's system) the aug-
ment वि at the end of a syllable of reduplication,
(see Intens. of rt. 2. द्युत्.)

विक विक, अम्, n. the milk of a cow that
has just calved.
विक्क विक्क, अस्, m. a young elephant.
वीक, अस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s.
III. 47

. fr. वी,
a substitute for rt. अज्), a bird; air, wind; the mind.

विकङ्कट वि-कङ्कट, अस्, m. the plant
Asteracantha Longifolia (= गो-क्षुर).

विकङ्कत वि-कङ्कत, अस्, m. a kind of tree
(= ग्रन्थिल).

विकच 1. वि-कच, अस्, आ, अम्, blown, opened,
expanded (as a flower &c.), spread; (अस्), m. a Bud-
dhist mendicant; epithet of Ketu or the personified
descending node.
—विकची-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति,
-कर्तुम्, to cause to blow or expand, to open.

2. वि-कच, अस्, आ, अम्, having no hair, hairless,
bald.

विकट 1. वि-कट, अस्, आ, अम् (see कट), large,
great; formidable, hideous, ugly, uncouth, horrible,
frightful; large-toothed; knitted (said of the brows),
frowning; changed in form or appearance; beautiful;
obscure, obsolete; (अस्), m. a proper N.; (अम्), n.
a boil, tumour; (आ), f. a kind of female divinity
peculiar to Buddhists.
—विकट-मूर्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, hav-
ing a hideous or distorted shape, deformed, ugly.
—विकटानन (˚ट-आन्˚), अस्, m. ‘ugly-faced,’ N.
of one of the sons of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.

2. वि-कट, अस्, आ, अम्, having no mat, without a
mat.

विकण्टक वि-कण्टक, अस्, m. a herbaceous
plant, Hedysarum Alhagi or Alhagi Maurorum (as
‘having no thorns’ or as ‘having spreading thorns,’
= यवास).

विकत्थ् वि-कत्थ्, cl. 1. A. -कत्थते (some-
times also P. -कत्थति), -कत्थितुम्, to boast, vaunt,
boast of (with inst., e. g. विद्यया विकत्थते, he
boasts of his learning); to praise, praise ironically,
mock; to humiliate; to speak ill of (with acc.); to
proclaim loudly, make a noise about anything.

वि-कत्थन, अस्, आ, अम्, boasting, vaunting,
boastful, speaking boastfully or ostentatiously, prais-
ing; praising ironically; (अम्), n. the act of boast-
ing; the act of proclaiming loudly; the act of prais-
ing, praise; ironical or false praise, irony.

वि-कत्थनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be vaunted, to be
boasted of, to be praised, commendable; to be praised
ironically; ridiculous.
वि-कत्थमान, अस्, आ, अम्, boasting, vaunting.

वि-कत्थयित्वा, ind. (anom. for वि-कत्थ्य), hav-
ing praised ironically, having mocked.

वि-कत्था, f. boasting, boast, vaunt; praise; ironi-
cal praise, irony; proclaiming.

वि-कत्थिन्, ई, इनी, इ, boasting, vaunting, pro-
claiming.

विकम्प् वि-कम्प्, cl. 1. A. -कम्पते, -कम्-
पितुम्, to tremble greatly, quiver, heave, move about,
move from or change a position; to become changed
or deformed; to shrink or retreat from: Caus. P.
-कम्पयति, -यितुम्, to cause to tremble, &c.
वि-कपित, अस्, आ, अम्, = वि-कम्पित.

वि-कम्प, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling, heaving; un-
steady, not firm, inconstant; shrinking from.

वि-कम्पमान, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling, quivering,
heaving.

वि-कम्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling, tremulous,
quivering, moving about, (अ-विकम्पित, not trem-
bling, immovable); palpitating, heaving; agitated,
unsteady, broken, interrupted; shrinking from.

विकर वि-कर, &c. See under वि-कृ,
p. 910, col. 1.
वि-कर, अस्, m. sickness, disease, loss of health.
विकार वि-कार, &c. See under वि-कृ.

वि-कार, अस्, m. change of form or nature, altera-
tion or deviation from any natural state; change for
the worse, change from a state of health, disease,
sickness; a wound; change of mind; change from
the quiescent condition of the soul, perturbation,
emotion, passion, feeling, excitement; (in the Sāṅkhya
philosophy) a production or that which is evolved
from a previous source or प्र-कृति, q. v., a modifi-
cation or result of the modification of the प्रकृतयः
or producers.
—विकार-तस्, ind. from change, through
change.
—विकार-त्व, अम्, n. the state of change,
condition of transforming, transformation.
2. वि-कार, अस्, m. the syllable वि.

विकराल वि-कराल, अस्, आ, अम्, very formida-
ble or terrible, frightful.
—विकराल-ता, f. formidable-
ness, dreadfulness.

विकर्ण 1. वि-कर्ण, अस्, ई, अम्, having large
ears; (अस्), m., N. of one of the Kuru princes (on
the side of Duryodhana in the war against the Pāṇ-
ḍavas).
2. वि-कर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, earless, having no ears.

वि-कर्णिक, अस्, m. the district called Sārasvata
(in the north-west of Hindūstān, generally considered
to be part of the Pañjāb, said to be so called as
being ‘the region from which Karṇa was excluded’).
विकर्तन वि-कर्तन. See under वि-कृत्.

वि-कर्तन, अस्, m. the sun; the plant Calotropis
Gigantea (= अर्क); a son who has usurped his
father's kingdom.
विकर्मन् वि-कर्मन्. See p. 910, col. 1.

1. वि-कर्मन्, अ, n. various business or duty; pro-
hibited or unlawful act, fraud; retiring from business;
(आ, आ, अ), acting variously; acting wrongly.
—वि-
कर्म-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, acting in various ways, acting
wrongly or illegally, one who does forbidden acts.
—विकर्म-क्रिया, f. an illegal or immoral act,
vicious conduct.
—विकर्म-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, doing
what is illegal or immoral, addicted to vice, engaged
in prohibited acts; engaged in various business.
2. वि-कर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, not acting, free from action.
विकर्ष वि-कर्ष, &c. See under वि-कृष्.

वि-कर्ष, अस्, m. dragging or drawing asunder,
pulling apart, pulling out; an arrow.

विकल वि-कल, अस्, आ, अम् (see कला), de-
prived of a part, destitute of a portion, deprived of
a limb or member, defective, imperfect; wanting,
failing; decayed, impaired, withered, waned; con-
fused, confounded, agitated, sorrowful; (अस्), m., N.
of a Daitya; (आ, ई), f. a woman in whom menstru-
ation has ceased; (आ), f. the sixtieth part of a
Kalā, the second of a degree.
—विकल-पाणिक, अस्,
m. one who has a mutilated or withered hand, a
cripple.
—विकल-वध, अस्, m. ‘death of Vikala,’
N. of a chapter in the Gaṇeśa-Purāṇa.
—विकलाङ्ग
(˚ल-अङ्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, having mutilated or defective
limbs, deformed, crippled, maimed.
—विकली-करण,
अम्, n. the act of depriving of a limb, mutilating,
maiming, breaking, spoiling; confusing, agitating.
—विकली-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to deprive
of a limb, mutilate, maim, spoil, break; to agitate,
confound.
—विकली-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, mutilated,
maimed, impaired, broken, injured; lame; sick;
confused, distressed.
—विकली-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्,
mutilated, maimed, defective; agitated, distressed.
—विकलेन्द्रिय (˚ल-इन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having any
of the organs of sense impaired or defective.

विकाल वि-काल, अस्, m. twilight, evening,
afternoon, the close of day; [cf. वैकालिक.]
विकल्प वि-कल्प, &c. See under वि-कॢप्.

वि-कल्प, अस्, m. alternation, alternative, option;
distinction; uncertainty, ambiguity; indecision, doubt,
hesitation; error, mistake, ignorance; (in rhetoric)
antithesis of opposites; (in grammar) admission of
an option or alternative, the allowing a rule to be
observed or not at pleasure; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a
people, (also read विकल्य.)
—विकल्प-जाल, a snare-
like dilemma from which there is no escape.
—विकल्-
पोपहार (˚प-उप्˚), अस्, m. an optional offering.

विकल्मष वि-कल्मष, अस्, आ, अम्, spotless,
sinless, guiltless.

विकश्वर वि-कश्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, for वि-कस्-
वर, col. 3.
वि-कष्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, for वि-कस्वर, col. 3.

वि-कस्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, opening, expanding; (आ),
f. a kind of plant (= रक्त-पुनर्नवा).

विकषा वि-कषा, f. = वि-कसा, Bengal mad-
der.
वि-कस, अस्, m. the moon; (आ), f. Bengal madder.

वि-कास, अस्, m. opening, expanding, expansion,
blossoming, blooming, budding.
विकास वि-कास, वि-कासित. See above.

1. वि-काश, अस्, m. appearance, becoming visible,
display, manifestation, exhibition; open or splendid
appearance; expanse, sky, heaven, ether; an open or
direct course (= प्रसार, Kirāt.
XV. 52

); an ob-
lique course (= विषम-गति, Kirāt.
XV. 52

);
opening; budding, blowing (as a flower, but in these
senses better वि-कास); pleasure, joy, enjoyment.
 — 1. विकाश-ता, f. or 1. विकाश-त्व, अम्, n. appear-
ance, display; expansion, diffusion.
—विकाश-भृत्,
त्, त्, त्, possessing expansion, full-blown.

2. वि-काश, अस्, m. absence of manifestation or
display, solitude, loneliness, privacy.
—२. विकाश-ता,
f. or 2. विकाश-त्व, अम्, n. absence of manifestation,
loneliness, solitude.

विकाश 1. वी-काश, अस्, m. (for 1. वि-काश),
manifestation, display; ether, heaven.

2. वी-काश, अस्, m. (for 2. वि-काश), absence of
manifestation; solitude, privacy.

विकस् वि-कस्, cl. 1. P. -कसति, -कसितुम्, to
burst, become split or divided or rent asunder; to
open, become expanded, blossom, bloom, blow (as
a flower): Caus. P. -कासयति, -यितुम्, to cause to
open, cause to expand or blow.

विकाश् वि-काश्, cl. 1. A. -काशते, -काशितुम्,
to appear, become visible, shine forth: Caus. P. -का-
शयति, -यितुम्, to cause to appear or shine forth, dis-
play, blazon abroad, publish; illuminate, make clear.

वि-कसत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, opening, expanding; bud-
ding, blowing; glowing.

वि-कसित, अस्, आ, अम्, blown (as a flower), budded,
opened, expanded.
—विकसित-कुमुदेन्दीवरालो-
किन् (˚द-इन्˚, ˚र-आल्˚), ई, इनी, इ, looking like the
expanded white and blue lotus.
—विकसित-वदन-
कमल, अस्, आ, अम्, opening [her] lotus-like mouth.

वि-कासित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to open or blow,
expanded; radiant, (in this sense better वि-काशित.)

वि-काशित, अस्, आ, अम्, made visible, displayed,
made to shine, illumined, resplendent; expanded.

वि-कस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. split or rent asunder,
divided, mutilated, (Sāy. = वि-च्छिन्न.)
वि-कासक, अस्, इका, अम्, causing to expand or blow.

वि-काशक, अस्, इका, अम्, displaying, causing to
appear or shine forth, illustrating; causing to expand
or bloom, opening (= वि-कासक).

वि-कासन, अम्, n. the causing to expand or blow,
expansion.

वि-काशन, अम्, n. manifestation, display, exhi-
bition, extent; expansion, blowing (of a flower; but
in this sense better वि-कासन); the causing to ex-
pand or blow (= वि-कासन).

वि-कासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, expanding, opening, budding,
blowing.

वि-काशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, becoming visible or apparent,
becoming manifested, shining forth; expanding, spread-
ing, developing, opening, budding, blowing, (in these
senses better वि-कासिन्.)

विकाषिन् वि-काषिन् for विकासिन् and विकाशिन्,
q. q. v. v.

विकाङ्क्षा वि-काङ्क्षा, f. freedom from de-
sire or eagerness, hesitation.

वि-कालक, अस्, m. twilight, evening; (इका), f. =
मान-रन्ध्रा, a perforated copper vessel (which
when placed in a pan of water marks the time by
gradually filling); a sort of clepsydra or water-clock.

विकिर वि-किर, वि-किरत्, &c. See under
वि-कॄ, p. 910, col. 3.

वि-किर, अस्, m. scattering, tearing, one who scat-
ters or tears, a bird, a scattered portion or fallen
fragment, anything dropped; a well.

विकुक्षि वि-कुक्षि, इस्, m., N. of a son of
Ikṣvāku.

विकुञ्च् वि-कुञ्च्, cl. 10. P. -कुञ्चयति, -यि-
तुम्, to contract; to bend or turn back.

वि-कुञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, contracted, crisped, curled;
drawn into wrinkles, knitted (as the brow), frowning.
—विकुञ्चित-ललाट-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, having a scowling
brow.

विकुण्ठ वि-कुण्ठ (perhaps ‘not blunted,’
[]
‘not worn out,’ ‘ever fresh;’ cf. अ-कुण्ठ), N. of
Viṣṇu's heaven; (आ), f., N. of the mother of Viṣṇu.

वि-कुण्ठित, अस्, आ, अम्, obtuse, blunt; weak,
feeble.
विकुस्र वि-कुस्र, अस्, m. (in Uṇādi-s.
II. 15

.
said to be fr. rt. कस् with वि), the moon, (said to
be also written वि-क्रस्र.)

विकूज् वि-कूज्, cl. 1. P. -कूजति, -कूजितुम्,
to coo, chirp, sing (as a bird &c.), make any cry or
sound, hum, buzz.

वि-कूजन, अम्, n. cooing, chirping, humming,
grumbling, rumbling, (अन्त्र-विकूजन, rumbling
of the bowels.)

विकूण् वि-कूण्, cl. 10. P. -कूणयति, -यितुम्,
Ved. to contract.
वि-कूणन, अम्, n. a side-glance, leer, wink.
वि-कूणिका, f. the nose.

विकृ वि-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते,
-कर्तुम्, to make different, form variously, give a
different shape to anything, transform, alter, change,
convert, cause to alter; to cause any one to change
his state or opinions; to cause to change for the
worse, distort, deprave, pervert, deform, render de-
formed, spoil; to display; to form or produce variously
(as sound, A.); to be changed, undergo a change,
change for the worse, deteriorate, change one's state or
opinions (A.); to rejoice (A.); to feel aversion (A.);
to act in various ways (A.); to decorate in various
manners; to move to and fro, become restless (A.);
to put into practice, exercise; to distribute; to ex-
tend; to destroy, annihilate; to act in a hostile or un-
friendly way towards (with gen. or loc. of the person);
to contend together: Pass. वि-क्रियते, &c., to be
changed, undergo a change; to act as a substitute for,
act in place of (with acc., Ved.): Caus. -कारयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to change or be changed.

विकॄ वि-कॄ, cl. 6. P. -किरति, -करितुम् or
-करीतुम्, to scatter in different directions, throw
about, sprinkle, toss about, disperse; to spread about,
expand, extend; to dissolve; to scatter over, over-
whelm, cover, fill with; to tear asunder, split, rend;
to revile; to contaminate.

वि-करण, अस्, m., scil. प्रत्यय, (in grammar)
a term for the affix or conjugational characteristic
which is placed between the root and terminations,
the inserted conjugational affix; (according to Pāṇini
these affixes are शप्, शपो लुक्, श्लु, श्यन्, श्नु,
श, श्नम्, उ, यक्, and च्लि with its substitutes तासि,
स्य, and सिप्, the first eight of which are added in
the Present, Imperfect, Imperative, and Potential,
and before a Kṛt which contains a mute palatal श्,
when these affixes denote the Kartṛ or Agent, i. e.
the Active; when, however, they denote the Karman
or Bhāva, i. e. the Passive or Neuter, then यक् is
added; च्लि is added in the Aorist, तासि in the Ist
Future, स्य in the 2nd Future and Conditional, and
सिप् before Leṭ.)

वि-कारित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to be changed, made
[]
to undergo a change, converted, perverted; rendered
unfavourable or unfriendly.

वि-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, producing a change, modifying;
undergoing a change; producing a change for the
worse, spoiling; feeling emotion, falling in love; (ई),
m., N. of the seventh year of Jupiter's cycle.

वि-कुर्वाण, अस्, आ, अम्, undergoing or causing
a change of form or of mind, &c.; feeling emotions
of joy, &c., rejoicing, being glad.

वि-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, altered, changed, modified, trans-
formed, changed in form or feeling; changed for the
worse, sick, diseased, mutilated, maimed, deformed,
disfigured; unnatural; imperfect, unfinished, incom-
plete; affected by passion, overcome by emotion; enter-
taining feelings of disgust or aversion, averse, estranged;
strange, extraordinary; (अम्), n. change, alteration;
change for the worse, a diseased state; disgust, aver-
sion.
—विकृत-दर्शन, अस्, आ, अम्, changed in
appearance.
—विकृत-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, changed
in mind, estranged, made unfriendly or ill-disposed.
—विकृत-लोचन, अस्, आ, अम्, having excited eyes.
—विकृत-वदन, अस्, आ, अम्, having a distorted
face, ugly-faced.
—विकृताकार (˚त-आक्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, changed in form or appearance, misshaped,
distorted in form.
—विकृताकृति (˚त-आक्˚), इस्, इस्, इ,
having a deformed shape or aspect.
—विकृताङ्ग
(˚त-अङ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, changed in form, having mis-
shaped limbs, deformed.
—विकृतानन (˚त-आन्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, having a distorted countenance, ugly-faced.

वि-कृति, इस्, f. change, alteration of any kind (as
of purpose, mind, form, nature, &c.), change from
a natural or healthy state, sickness, disease; change
from a quiescent state, emotion, anger, wrath, fear;
(in the Sāṅkhya philosophy) a production or that
which is evolved from a previous प्र-कृति or pro-
ducer (see वि-कार, col. 1); fermented or spirituous
liquor; a species of metre (the stanza consisting of
four lines of two syllables each, variously arranged);
= डिम्भ (according to Śabda-k.); (इस्), m., N. of
a king.
—विकृति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of
change, changed; diseased, wounded; changeable.
—विकृति-विज्ञानीय, N. of a chapter in the Ash-
ṭāṅga-hṛdaya-saṃhitā.
वि-कृती, f. = वि-कृति above.

वि-क्रिया, f. alteration, change; transformation,
change of mind, &c., any change from a natural or
quiescent state, disease, injury, mischief, emotion,
anger, any sudden affection or seizure [cf. भूत-व्˚,
रोम-व्˚]; a preparation or dish of rice, &c.
विक्रिया वि-क्रिया. See p. 910, col. 2.
वि-क्रीय, ind. having sold.

विकृत् वि-कृत्, cl. 6. P. -कृन्तति, -कर्तितुम्,
to cut into or through, divide by cutting, tear to
pieces, destroy.
वि-कर्त, वि-कर्त्तृ in गो-व्˚, q. q. v. v.

विकृश् वि-कृश्, Caus. -कर्शयति, -यितुम्, to
make thin, emaciate, attenuate; to distort, deform.

विकृष् वि-कृष्, cl. 1. P. -कर्षति, cl. 6. P.

hair; N. of the wife of Śiva manifested in the form
of Mahī or the Earth (one of his eight Tanus or
visible forms).

वि-केशिका, f. a piece of rag smeared with ghee or
other substances and applied as a dressing to a sore,

विकोक वि-कोक, अस्, m. [cf. कोक], N. of an
Asura (son of Vṛka and killed by Kalki).

out a case or covering, without a husk, unsheathed
(as a sword &c.), uncovered, denuded.

desire or curiosity, incurious, indifferent.

विक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, separated; empty, (probably for

विक्रन्दित वि-क्रन्दित, अस्, आ, अम् (see rt.
क्रन्द्), crying or calling out, complaint.

वि-क्रम, अस्, m. stepping or going beyond, step-
ping or striding over; a step, stride, pace [cf. त्रि-व्˚];
going, proceeding, walking; overpowering, overcom-
ing; heroism, prowess, heroic valour, great power or
strength; strength in general, (विक्रमं कृ, to dis-
play prowess, use one's strength); N. of a king, (see
विक्रमादित्य); N. of Viṣṇu; of a city; of the forty-
eighth year of Jupiter's cycle.
—विक्रम-कर्मन्, अ,
n. an act of prowess, feat of valour.
—विक्रम-केश-
रिन्, ई, m. ‘valour-lion,’ N. of king Vikramāditya.
—विक्रम-चरित or विक्रम-चरित्र, अम्, n.
‘Vikrama's acts,’ N. of thirty-two stories (describ-
ing the acts of Vikramāditya).
—विक्रम-बाहु,
उस्, m., N. of a king.
—विक्रम-सिंह or विक्रम-
सेन, अस्, m., N. of king Vikramāditya.
—विक्रम-
हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of valour, wanting in
courage.
—विक्रमादित्य (˚म-आद्˚), अस्, m. ‘valour-
sun,’ N. of a celebrated Hindū king (of Ujjayinī or
Oujein and founder of the era called Saṃvat [see
संवत्], which begins 57 B. C.; he is said to have
driven out the Śakas or Scythians and to have esta-
blished his dominion over almost the whole of
Northern India; he was one of the wisest of Hindū
kings and a great patron of literature; nine cele-
brated men of letters flourished at his court [see
नव-रत्न], and innumerable legends are related
of him [cf. विक्रम-चरित, सिंहासन-द्वात्रिंशत्-
पुत्रिका-वार्त्ता] all teeming with exaggerations and
absurdities; according to some he fell in a battle
with his rival Śāli-vāhana, king of the south country
or Deccan, and the legendary date given for his death
is Kali Yuga 3044; there are, however, other kings
called Vikramāditya, and the name has been applied
to king Bhoja and even to Śāli-vāhana).
—विक्र-
मादित्य-कोष, N. of a work.
—विक्रमार्क
(˚म-अर्˚), अस्, m., N. of king Vikramāditya.
—वि-

quered by valour.

वि-क्रममाण, अस्, आ, अम्, stepping or passing

gressive; (ई), m. a hero; a lion; N. of Viṣṇu.

य-पत्त्र, अम्, n. a bill of sale.
—विक्रयानुशय

—विक्रयार्थम्
(˚य-अर्˚), ind. for sale.
विक्रस्र वि-क्रस्र = वि-कुस्र, q. v.

वि-क्रेतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who sells, a vender,

plexity, alarm, fear; looking about vaguely or wildly;

वि-क्षोभित, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken about, agitated,
